svg.title: Hold geometry and color fixed; change only the surface response
svg.desc: Three software-rendered spheres use identical shape, color, view and light. Increasing the illustrative roughness parameter broadens and weakens the specular lobe. A graph shows the corresponding angular lobe shapes.
svg.text: Hold geometry and color fixed; change only the surface response
All three renders use the same sphere, base color, light direction, and camera.
Only the width/intensity control of this illustrative specular term changes.
Software teaching model: exponent = max(0.3, 2 / r² − 2), not Unreal’s BRDF.
A normal map changes the shading normal; a roughness map changes the response around it.
Material parameters describe a response to illumination; they do not contain the light itself.
